_comment: The category-name match behind 'a search term that names a category shows the whole category', pinned for BOTH implementations: domain/category_match.py (tests/python/test_category_name_match.py, used by `dubis search --category-hit`) and js/inventory/inventory-logic.js `matchesCategoryName` (tests/js/inventory-logic.test.js). The rule: the query's alphanumeric tokens must appear as a CONTIGUOUS RUN inside the section key's tokens. So `ic` never matches `ICs`, `switch` never matches `Switches`, and no substring of a word ever matches — the failure mode this feature must not have is one short letter swallowing the grid. Sections are the real keys from data/constants.json SECTION_ORDER.
